title: MCP Compliance Gap Map v1
overall_status: non_compliant — MCP must be blocked from mutation-tier operations until governance pipeline is integrated

gaps.current: 13 of 17 tools return hardcoded stub data. No delegation to AgentLoop, ToolExecutor, or CouncilGate.
gaps.required: All tools must dispatch through the governance pipeline: permission check → council consultation → tool execution → evidence envelope.

gaps.current: compute_tool_provenance_hash() exists in _auth_metadata.py but is never called in server.py. Tool dispatch matches by bare string name.
gaps.required: Tool descriptor must be hashed at registration time. Provenance hash must be verified BEFORE handler invocation at dispatch time. Mismatch → refusal.

gaps.current: Tier-4/5 gate checks string presence of authorization_receipt. Any string passes. No cryptographic verification.
gaps.required: Tier-4/5 tools must be hard-blocked with cryptographic refusal until HMAC-signed, time-bound, scope-bound approval receipts are verified server-side.

gaps.current: MCPPerUserAuthorization model exists but is never instantiated or checked. No actor_id, no user_id_hash, no session scoping, no scope enforcement, no expiry check.
gaps.required: Per-user auth with token-gated connection. Per-session authz with scoped tool grants. Expiry-checked. MCP client identity registered and auditable.

gaps.current: Server advertises content_light: True but never scans tool responses for sensitive content. No content classification applied.
gaps.required: Integrate redaction.py content-light scanning into MCP response path. Every tool response must carry content_light_classification.

gaps.current: Tool call results are ad-hoc dicts. No rig.relay.tool.* events emitted. None of 16 common envelope fields appear.
gaps.required: Emit evidence envelopes with all required fields for every MCP tool call. Include request_id, session_id, actor_id, surface (mcp), authority_tier, capability_id, input_hash, output_hash, payload_schema, etc.

gaps.current: Sync JSON-RPC handler missing tools/call. Async handler supports it.
gaps.required: Add tools/call to sync handler or reject sync transport connections with clear error.

gaps.current: 16 cross-surface envelope fields absent from MCPTool, MCPResource, MCPPrompt, ServerCapabilities.
gaps.required: Add cross-surface authority spine fields to MCP models or wrap tool responses in common evidence envelope.

gaps.current: Tools use Path.cwd() directly with no workspace root boundary enforcement. No path traversal protection.
gaps.required: Enforce workspace root boundaries. Reject path traversal attempts with refusal envelope.

gaps.current: No sampling/createMessage handler. No sampling policy configuration. No capability gate for sampling.
gaps.required: Sampling must be gated by explicit policy. Sampling requests must produce evidence envelopes. Disable sampling until policy exists.

gaps.current: MCP resources and prompts exposed without sensitivity classification.
gaps.required: Classify every MCP resource and prompt by sensitivity. Reject exposure of unclassified resources.
